summary: A good daily: Corolla, Civic, Camry, the F-150 and the Beetle come fast, Passat and Hilux are the stretch, and the Model T and Mustang are costly near misses that show their figures.
reasons: Casual found 7 (Corolla, F-150, Beetle, Civic, Camry, Accord, Golf) and lost 3 lives on the Model T, Mustang and Wrangler, each showing units sold; RAV4, Model 3, Silverado and Focus are free. A fan gets 10/10, losing 3.

Brand guesses misfire: 'toyota' offers only Mirai and Prius, 'ford' only Model T and Mustang, 'volkswagen' is corrected to the Type 2, so a make points at costly unranked models while its top-10 models stay hidden.
Not a Blitz: the page lists one best seller per brand, so 12 of 26 quick casual names (RAV4, CR-V, Silverado, Model 3, Focus, Tacoma) are 'not an answer' and score nothing; 14 scored.
fixes: Bare makes should read as 'be more specific' (free) on this list instead of offering or correcting to an unranked model: 'toyota' offers Toyota Mirai / Toyota Prius, 'ford' offers Ford Model T / Ford Mustang, 'volkswagen' and 'volkswagon' are corrected to Volkswagen Type 2 (nameStrip hides those makes' top-10 models), and likewise 'chevrolet' to Chevrolet Impala, 'jeep' to Jeep Wrangler, 'nissan' offers Nissan Sunny / Nissan Z-car, 'mazda' offers three Mazdas.
'cutlass' is corrected to Mercedes-Benz C-Class; add 'Cutlass' and 'Oldsmobile Cutlass' as aliases of Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme.

Pool aliases: drop the plain-word aliases 'Series' (Land Rover Series; 'series' costs a life) and 'Metropolitan' (Nash Metropolitan) left by rename; split the glued aliases 'Nissan Sunny/Sentra/Pulsar/Almera', 'Series/Defender', 'VAZ-2105/04/07' and 'Iso/BMW/VELAM/Romi Isetta' into names, so 'nissan sentra' reaches Nissan Sunny.
